doc: Cloud fraction at Hadley edge 30 with a NaN, +inf and -inf ITCZ shift (inputs.itcz_shift_deg, rows in that order) on the latitudes of inputs.lat_deg: a NaN shift makes every output NaN; an infinite shift sends x_itcz to infinity, the ITCZ gaussian to 0, and the profile is the one without the ITCZ bump (finite, the same for both signs). Float64: rtol 1e-9. NaN and infinities may appear in the inputs (a rotation period None is stored as NaN) and in the outputs: NaN equals NaN, an infinity equals the same infinity (sign included).
